description: Launch to sync verdict (O8): restart the app against an already-populated profile and read the SOL op=startup timeline.
notes: config_seed copies a real Foxy configuration directory (repositories, spaces, warm database) into the isolated config directory once per run, so the case measures a populated profile instead of a bootstrap. The source is only read, and require_no_other_foxy is what keeps the copy from being torn by a running app.
